mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) for 3 consecutive months indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a low UNRATE (< 5%) signals a strong labor market, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO and HOUST both exhibit YoY growth > 5%, it signals a supply-side boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances with joint YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery, a RSAFS increase > 10% MoM signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window during post-shock recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Threshold-triggered: a FEDFUNDS increase > 1.5% within 2 months signals impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS increase > 1.5% in 2mo.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: a high PAYEMS (> 140,000) signals a strong labor market, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when GDPC1 and RSAFS both exhibit YoY growth > 3%, it signals a demand-side boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with joint YoY growth > 3%.
